verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. Users can review their prompts and delete their Gemini Apps activity in My Activity, which supports leaving (gemini-docs-31), and generated images can be downloaded (gemini-docs-27). Nothing documents a bulk export of chats, Gems, notebooks or memory in open formats. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (e.g. chat history, Gems, notebooks), open or standard export formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export-and-leave path.
